game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge, the basecamp on a ridge: the mountaineer must hold off avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Letter Lock: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the summit beacon.
theme: Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge: the basecamp on a ridge
core_gameplay_loop: In Basecamp Ridge, repeat each round: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the summit beacon. Then check lock_letters and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from avalanches in Basecamp Ridge: keep lock_letters above zero until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Letter Lock
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 1, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
